name: Delivery route → BLOCKED: the cold verify failed → park toward the human
description:
The blocked delivery route (design R1/D16/SB5, group 5). When the clean-room cold verify FAILED (verify.cleanroom.result=fail) — the committed artifact did not prove cold (not self-contained, a warm-cache-masked fabrication survived, or a forbidden build-file pattern) — the run cannot deliver a coherent PR. PARK toward the human. A run that cannot prove its delivery signals NEVER ships a PR (the class both predecessors faked, inverted).

WHY verify.cleanroom.result=fail IS THE BLOCK: only APPROVED work is cold-verified (07a fires on approved), and openspec.change.validated is required to have reached the approval gate — so by the time verify runs, review + validation are green invariants, and the only signal that can block delivery is the cold verify. So blocked = verify.cleanroom.result eq "fail" (fail-closed for the realistic case). A 'retry' verify (transient flake) matches neither this nor 08a — it re-runs rather than parking a good run.

TRIGGER (on the RUN, like 08a): verify.cleanroom.result eq "fail" (required:false) AND delivery.route.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). Mutually exclusive with the coherent route (08a, verify.cleanroom.result=pass) on the verify result.

WRITER: run.awaiting.human — a sanctioned park realization (G5), same meaning as the others. SELF-EXTINGUISHING: delivery.route.routed on the run (shared with 08a; a run-scoped guard is correct since delivery is terminal). It fires on the run, so the park marker stamps $entity.id (the run) directly — no subject-override.

on_enter.subject: $entity.id
on_enter.object: the clean-room cold verify of the committed artifact failed; the run cannot deliver a coherent PR
